name: standing-crew
description: The daily-driver crew behind the starter prompt: a coordinator, the memory scaffolding practice, the house voice shape, an evidence habit, and an independent checker.
when_to_use: Use as the standing setup for everyday sessions where we want memory kept, output shaped for quick reading, and claims backed by shown work.

routines.description: Load the memory scaffolding and the house rules, confirm the target of the session, and only then dispatch work.
routines.name: Session start

routines.description: Record what changed, what was verified, and what remains open, so the next session starts from the record rather than from memory.
routines.name: Session close
